hero#0|deck|eyebrow,headline,sub-line,bu.03_sub_line: Handcrafted sourdough, flaky croissants, and exquisite cakes baked with tradition for you.

feature cards#0|deck|headline,sub-line.02_sub_line: Taste the tradition with our fresh sourdough, delicate croissants, and sweet cakes made daily for our local community.

items.title: Artisan Sourdough
items.sentence: Slow-fermented, naturally tangy sourdough baked fresh daily. Our signature crust and soft interior make every slice a delight.

items.title: Flaky Croissants
items.sentence: Golden, buttery, and perfectly flaky croissants made with the finest European butter. The ultimate morning indulgence.

items.title: Signature Cakes
items.sentence: Beautifully crafted cakes for every occasion, from rich chocolate to delicate fruit fillings. Celebrate with us.

about#0|deck|eyebrow,headline,sub-line,p.03_sub_line: Crafting the finest sourdough, buttery croissants, and beautiful cakes for the Lyonnaise community.
about#0|deck|eyebrow,headline,sub-line,p.04_paragraph: Step into our warm, traditional kitchen where generations of family recipes meet the finest local ingredients. From the slow fermentation of our sourdough to the delicate layers of our croissants and stunning cakes, we bring the heart of Lyon's baking tradition directly to your table.
about#0|deck|eyebrow,headline,sub-line,p.05_quote: Our passion is simple: to bake with love, using time-honored methods to create the perfect bite for your day.

gallery#0|deck|headline,sub-line.01_headline: Lyon Family Bakery: Baked with Love
gallery#0|deck|headline,sub-line.02_sub_line: Experience the warmth of a family-run bakery, serving Lyon with artisanal sourdough, flaky croissants, and exquisite cakes.

items.title: Artisan Sourdough Boule
items.sentence: Slow-fermented for incredible flavor and a perfect, chewy crust. Baked fresh daily.

items.title: Butter Croissant Classique
items.sentence: Flaky, buttery perfection, laminated daily with French technique. A true morning delight.

items.title: Chocolate Decadent Gateau
items.sentence: Rich dark chocolate layers with creamy ganache. Our signature decadent dessert.

items.title: Seasonal Fruit Tart
items.sentence: Sweet pastry topped with seasonal fresh fruit. A beautiful and light treat.

items.title: Almond Brioche Swirl
items.sentence: Golden, sweet, and tender brioche with toasted almonds. Perfect for any time of day.

items.title: Classic Kouign-Amann
items.sentence: Rich, caramelized pastry layered with butter and sugar. A buttery masterpiece.
